Subject: Procurement: Pre-approve PO bridge & vendor onboarding refresh

Hi Olivia / HelioMed procurement team —

Quick context: HelioMed is moving forward with the renewal + capacity uplift we discussed (term amendment and +40% committed capacity). Legal and finance are finalizing the SOW amendment but that process will take ~2–3 business days. To avoid any service disruption while we finish paperwork, Finance has requested a short bridge PO that HelioMed can issue to Redwood to cover the first billing cycle.

Ask: Can your procurement team pre-approve a short-term PO (covering up to $120,000) so we can continue provisioning the added capacity tomorrow? We will:
- Send the finalized SOW amendment and updated pricing by EOD tomorrow (attached draft SOW v2).
- Accept a bridging PO using HelioMed's PO template (attached sample).
- Escalate to our legal ops for any minor redlines and cut over billing on receipt of the signed amendment.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation that Procurement can accept a pre-approved PO and the preferred PO reference format.
- Any outstanding vendor onboarding evidence you still need (e.g., SOC 2 link, upload location).

I copied Karthik + Stephanie to confirm Redwood-side approvals and to surface any evidence we need to upload.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_renewal_v2.pdf (draft), HelioMed_PO-template.xlsx (example mapping)

Thanks — appreciate a quick thumbs-up so we can avoid throttling while the legal loop finishes.

—
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — thanks for the note and the attachments. A few quick questions so Procurement can expedite: 

1) Exact PO amount to pre-approve — you wrote up to $120k; can you confirm the precise dollar amount you will invoice for the first cycle? We prefer fixed amounts on the PO.
2) Term dates — will the bridge PO reference the renewal term start date or be dated to the invoice date?
3) Vendor evidence — we still need an updated SOC 2 attestation link and the contact for Redwood security if procurement needs to run a short questionnaire. We already have last year’s attestation, but our portal requires a current doc.

We can turn around a pre-approved PO same-day once those items are confirmed. For PO format, please populate the attached template and send back to procure@heliomed.com with your requested PO number.

Thanks,
Olivia

Thanks Olivia — answers inline and next steps below.

> 1) Exact PO amount to pre-approve — you wrote up to $120k; can you confirm the precise dollar amount you will invoice for the first cycle? We prefer fixed amounts on the PO.
We will invoice $118,750 for the first cycle (covers the committed uplift prorated to the billing cycle). Please use $118,750 as the PO amount.

> 2) Term dates — will the bridge PO reference the renewal term start date or be dated to the invoice date?
Please date the PO to the invoice date (we will list the renewal term on the SOW amendment once signed).

> 3) Vendor evidence — we still need an updated SOC 2 attestation link and the contact for Redwood security if procurement needs to run a short questionnaire.
SOC 2 link (current): https://redwood.com/security/soc2/2028-attestation.pdf
Security contact: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com). Stephanie will coordinate the portal upload — Stephanie, can you confirm the upload location and whether HelioMed needs any additional forms?

Next steps (proposed):
- HelioMed to issue PO for $118,750 to procure@heliomed.com with PO reference "HLMD-PO-118750".
- Redwood to send final SOW amendment + DocuSign link EOD tomorrow.
- Stephanie to upload SOC 2 and any requested evidence to HelioMed's portal (or provide scp/FTPS link).

Cc'ing Rishi for finance sign-off — Rishi, can Finance accept the bridging PO and invoice on receipt while legal finalizes the amendment?

Best,
Vanessa
